title: Validation Harness Foundation
charter_mapping: Charter Phase 0 (backtest harness, build FIRST) + Phase 1 (point-in-time data foundation)
objective: Build the measuring instrument before any factor or model: a point-in-time data foundation plus a purged walk-forward harness reporting the full metrics suite and three anti-self-deception safeguards.
key_deliverables: Point-in-time PostgreSQL schema storing data vintages; free-data ingestion (yfinance, FRED, SEC EDGAR); purged cross-validation with embargo; single-touch OOS holdout; deflated-Sharpe + configuration counter; per-regime / per-subperiod decomposition; realistic cost/turnover model; equal-weight benchmark harness (reuse audited Phase 5-C walk-forward machinery).
dependencies: Charter Sections 1, 2, 6; existing Phase 5-C walk-forward harness; local FRED series.
exit_criteria: Harness reproduces a known baseline IC; purged CV + embargo verified leakage-clean; deflated Sharpe + config count operational; point-in-time DB returns only knowable-as-of data; equal-weight benchmark wired as the baseline to beat.
builds: The validation framework (the arbiter for every later phase).
stops: Single-signal hunting, strategy-filter loops, any model built before the instrument that measures it exists.

title: Multi-Factor Ranking Engine
key_deliverables: Compute the six single-name factor buckets, normalize cross-sectionally, and combine EQUAL WEIGHT into a composite cross-sectional rank of the S&P 500 (System 1).
dependencies: Per-bucket factor modules (Value, Momentum, Quality, Volatility, Growth, Sentiment/Flow); cross-sectional z-score + winsorize at +/-3 + sector-neutralize; equal-weight composite; ranked list of ~500 names; per-factor IC diagnostics run through the 7B harness.
exit_criteria: Phase 7B harness trusted; data foundation populated point-in-time.
builds: Each factor computed point-in-time and z-scored/winsorized/sector-neutralized; equal-weight composite beats or ties the equal-weight benchmark out-of-sample through the harness; NO weight optimization performed.
column11: Prediction-oracle framing, early weight optimization, adding factors before the harness validates them.

title: Risk Decomposition
objective: Decompose every position into separable exposures (market beta, rate/duration, sector/factor, idiosyncratic) and aggregate to a whole-book consolidated risk view. Measurement only, no hedging.
key_deliverables: Factor exposure matrix; net portfolio beta = sum(weight*beta); net duration; sector-concentration and factor-tilt aggregation; CFO-readable consolidated risk dashboard artifact.
dependencies: Phase 7C ranking engine producing a candidate book.
exit_criteria: Every position decomposes to its factor contributions; book-level net exposures reconcile; dashboard is institutional-grade and readable without the model.
builds: The consolidated risk monitor (risk as a property of the whole book).
stops: Single-position risk framing; any hedging/order/automation (explicitly deferred).

title: Regime Overlay
objective: Macro-indicator regime classifier (risk-on / neutral / risk-off) that throttles HOW MUCH risk and WHICH factor buckets — a posture overlay on System 1, never a standalone oracle.
key_deliverables: Regime classifier from macro indicators (VIX term structure, HY/IG credit spreads, yield curve 10Y-3M/10Y-2Y, breadth, MOVE, real yields); dynamic factor-bucket weight tilts; regime-decomposed validation through the 7B harness.
dependencies: System 1 trusted over months; cross-asset macro data collected (ties to Phase 6-B/6-C; currently NEEDS_ADDITIONAL_PROXY_COLLECTION — data BLOCKED).
exit_criteria: Classifier validated out-of-sample per regime; overlay improves robustness (not just headline Sharpe); owner explicitly endorses the weighting philosophy before any optimization.
builds: System 2 — the regime/risk throttle on top of System 1.
stops: Treating the regime signal as a prediction oracle; deploying the overlay before System 1 is trusted; optimizing factor weights without owner endorsement.
